integrity: Analytical strict-convexity proof with standalone symbolic and direct numerical supplementary checks. Publication priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact single normal damped planar oscillator only; objective is squared-norm damping and not approximation error or multieigenvalue minimax. Zero-duration substeps are allowed; in that phase positive-only splits attain only an infimum.
title: Exact phase diagram for fixed-budget two-step Cayley damping
